Manor

Villa in Bang Tao
HomeNew ProjectsManor

Marketing images (mostly artist renders) supplied via Keller Henson and Papaya Property. Images belong to their respective owners; layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A phased development of single-storey three and four-bedroom pool villas in the Si Sunthon area of Thalang, divided into zones such as Manor, Arcadia, Luxe and Mori. Ownership for foreigners is by 30-year leasehold, renewable.

Facilities & amenities

  • 24/7 security
  • CCTV
  • Covered parking
  • Landscaped gardens
  • Swimming pool
  • Shuttle service (Papaya)
